title: 第2章  绝交吧
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
奴隶主很会察言观色，看她满意，立马抬价，要了两万金币。
还行，原主卡里还有十万金币。
姜知夏淡定递卡。
奴隶主接过卡，眼睛都快笑没了。
银发少年艰难的爬出来，跪在地上，一动不动。
刚才对自己的那些介绍，他听得清清楚楚，这位雌性应该是要买他回去当出气筒的。
他心中期盼，她下手能重一些。
最好能让自己尽快解脱。
奴隶主见他不动，抬脚又要踹。
姜知夏立马叉腰，眼睛一瞪：“谁让你动手的？”
她语气骄横：“谁允许你动我的东西了？”
奴隶主反应过来，连忙躬身退开，“殿下恕罪！”
他双手捧起拴在陆决身上的锁链，连同钥匙一起递给她。
“您请拿好。”
姜知夏接过链子，心里一阵激动。
成功了！
她看着那串钥匙，犹豫了一下，反手揣起来。
不能现在解开，万一他跑了，两万金币不就打水漂了？
她牵起锁链转身。
“走吧。”

在陆决的视野里，只能看到一双纤细的脚踝和摇曳的裙摆。
他咬住止咬器，四肢僵硬地跟上。
没走几步，那双脚忽然停了下来。
陆决浑身一僵。
难道……她迫不及待要在这里折磨他？
他下意识绷紧身体。
姜知夏看着跪行的陆决，无奈叹口气，将钥匙扔给奴隶主。
“把他身上的铁链都解开。”
“啊？全部？”
“嗯，除了脖子上这个。”
铁链脱落，姜知夏低头看他：“能站起来吗？”
陆决模糊地听清了问话。
他点点头，摇摇晃晃地站了起来，脚底传来尖锐的刺痛。
姜知夏松了口气，牵着他继续往外走。
刚走出奴隶场，一个清脆的女声忽然传来。
“三殿下！”
姜知夏下意识抬头。
一个扎着马尾的雌性正朝她快步走来，脸上是惊喜表情。
曾雯雯，原主的闺蜜啊……
她淡漠移开眼。

“哼……”
身后传来一声闷哼。
她瞟到身后的人在摇晃，眼疾手快转身扶了他一把。
陆决只是因为太疼了，一时失神。
等他反应过来，发现自己撞进了新主人的怀里！
他惊愕地瞪大眼睛，挣扎着想站直，却因为虚弱，反而在对方的衣服上蹭上了血迹。
他浑身僵住，不敢再乱动。
雄性天生身材高大，姜知夏扶着有点费劲儿，索性抬手示意侍卫直接把车开过来。
她还感觉他浑身抖的厉害，以为是伤的太重撑不住了。
曾雯雯已经跳到了她面前。
“殿下，我可算找到你了！你怎么来这种地方呀？”她语气亲昵，但满脸不赞同，目光扫过陆决，更是嫌弃，“这种地方多掉价呀！你还碰这种奴隶，要是让白哥哥知道了，肯定又要嫌弃你了！”
姜知夏淡淡瞟了她一眼。
曾雯雯像是得到了鼓励，说得更起劲了：“要我说，你真该好好学学皇家礼仪，端庄一点，温柔一点，白哥哥才会喜欢你嘛！”
她的目光忽然落在陆决侧脸上。
那里，暗色的刺青组成了罪奴的标志。
她夸张地捂住嘴：“天啊！这还是个罪奴？！殿下，你怎么能和罪奴挨这么近！白哥哥知道肯定更反感你了！”
姜知夏被吵的耐心告罄，“闭嘴。”
曾雯雯一愣，没反应过来。
姜知夏懒得搭理她。
这个所谓的闺蜜，出身小门小户，精神力和原主一样弱，原主因为同病相怜，将她视为真正的朋友，十分珍惜。

但这位朋友，却借着原主的名头在外面肆意捞好处，时不时用原主喜欢的雄性白知遇来PUA原主，后期真千金回归，也是第一个跳出来落井下石，向新公主表忠心的。
姜知夏现在并没有维持塑料姐妹情的兴趣，注意力都在靠着自己的男人身上。
侍卫赶过来，一脸淡定将半昏迷的陆决扶进车里。
她也打算上车，却被曾雯雯挡住。
“殿下，你今天怎么回事啊！我可是为您好！您要是不听我的，白哥哥以后真的不会再理您了！”
“嗯嗯行，”姜知夏不耐烦的挥挥手，“你起开，别挡路。”
曾雯雯震惊了。
以前的姜知夏，只要一听说白知遇不理她，就会慌张失措，对她言听计从。
今天这是怎么了？
“公主殿下！今天可是白哥哥的生日聚会，我们马上就迟到了，你还不快点把这个奴隶扔了跟我一起去吗？”
姜知夏眼都没抬：“那你自己去不就好了，起开！”
曾雯雯惊愕，眼中闪过一丝难堪。
白知遇的聚会如果没有皇室引荐，自己是没有资格进去的。
她在故意刁难自己？！
她咬咬牙，使出杀手锏：“你，你不听我的……我再也不理你了！”
姜知夏终于正眼看了她一眼。
她指了指自己：“你刚才叫我什么？”
曾雯雯懵了：“公主殿下……”
“对啊，”她微微一笑，明艳动人，“你也配对本公主指手画脚？”
曾雯雯的脸色瞬间涨红。

姜知夏绕过她，弯腰上车。
曾雯雯气急败坏地冲到车边：“姜知夏！你什么意思！我可是你唯一的朋友！”
车窗缓缓降下。
曾雯雯眼睛一亮，以为她要服软了。
姜知夏探出半个脑袋看她。
“哦，对了，我觉得你不配做我的朋友，绝交吧，你回头记得把这些年借走的衣服包包首饰还有钱，全部还回来。”
“你、你说什么……”
姜知夏笑容更盛，“不还的话，我会让大哥亲自处理你们曾家哦。”
车窗升起，悬浮车眨眼间消失不见。
曾雯雯呆呆地站在原地。
她……她疯了吧？
陆决以为自己已经死了。
不然怎么会有人这么温柔的抚摸他？
他感觉身上疼到麻木的伤口被一阵温柔的力量拂过，虽然微弱，但却是致命的诱惑……
姜知夏无语的收回爪子。
回到别墅以后，她试着调动自己的精神力，想看看能不能帮陆决缓解一点痛苦。
嗯，效果微乎其微。
对方连眼皮都没睁开。
她叹口气，认命的刨出医疗箱，给他上药包扎。
content_en:
The slave owner was very good at observing her words. Seeing that she was satisfied, he immediately raised the price and asked for 20,000 gold coins.
Not bad, the original owner still has 100,000 gold coins in his card.
Jiang Zhixia calmly handed over the card.
The slave owner took the card and smiled almost out of his eyes.
The silver-haired boy climbed out with difficulty and knelt on the ground, motionless.
He could clearly hear the introduction to him just now. This female probably wanted to buy him back as a punching bag.
He hoped in his heart that she would be more aggressive.
It's best to free yourself as soon as possible.
When the slave owner saw that he was not moving, he raised his foot to kick him again.
Jiang Zhixia immediately put her hands on her hips and stared: "Who asked you to do it?"
She spoke in an arrogant tone: "Who allowed you to touch my things?"
The slave owner reacted and quickly bowed away, "Your Highness, forgive me!"
He held the chain tied to Lu Jue with both hands and handed it to her along with the key.
"Please take it."
Jiang Zhixia took the chain and felt excited.
Success!
She looked at the bunch of keys, hesitated, and put them in her backhand.
We can't untie it now. If he runs away, won't the 20,000 gold coins be wasted?
She took the chain and turned around.
"Let's go."
In Lu Jue's field of vision, he could only see a pair of slender ankles and a swaying skirt.
He bit the bite stopper and followed with stiff limbs.
After taking a few steps, the feet suddenly stopped.
Lu Jue froze.
Could it be that...she couldn't wait to torture him here?
He tensed up subconsciously.
Jiang Zhixia looked at Lu Jue kneeling, sighed helplessly, and threw the key to the slave owner.
"Untie all the chains on him."
"Huh? All of them?"
"Well, except for the one around my neck."
The chains fell off, and Jiang Zhixia looked down at him: "Can you stand up?"
Lu Jue vaguely heard the question.
He nodded and stood up unsteadily, feeling a sharp pain in the soles of his feet.
Jiang Zhixia breathed a sigh of relief and continued walking out with him.
As soon as he walked out of the slave farm, a clear female voice suddenly came.
"Your Highness, Third Prince!"
Jiang Zhixia subconsciously raised her head.
A female with a ponytail was walking quickly towards her, with an expression of surprise on her face.
Zeng Wenwen, the original owner’s best friend...
She looked away indifferently.
"Hmph..."
There was a muffled groan from behind.
She caught a glimpse of the person behind her shaking, and quickly turned around to give him a hand.
Lu Jue was temporarily distracted because he was in too much pain.
When he reacted, he found that he had crashed into the arms of his new owner!
His eyes widened in shock, and he struggled to stand up straight, but because of his weakness, he got blood stains on the other person's clothes.
He froze, not daring to move any more.
The male was naturally tall, so Jiang Zhixia found it a bit difficult to support him, so he simply raised his hand to signal the guards to drive over directly.
She also felt that his whole body was shaking violently, and she thought that he was too injured and could not hold on.
Zeng Wenwen had already jumped in front of her.
"Your Highness, I finally found you! Why did you come to a place like this?" Her tone was friendly, but her face was full of disapproval. She glanced at Lu Jue and felt even more disgusted. "The price of this kind of place is so low! If you still touch this kind of slave, if Brother Bai finds out, he will definitely dislike you again!"
Jiang Zhixia glanced at her lightly.
Zeng Wenwen seemed to be encouraged and spoke more energetically: "If you ask me, you should really learn royal etiquette, be more dignified and gentle, then Brother Bai will like you!"
Her eyes suddenly fell on the side of Lu Jue's face.
There, dark tattoos formed the symbol of the sin slave.
She covered her mouth exaggeratedly: "Oh my god! Is this a sin slave?! Your Highness, how can you be so close to a sin slave! Brother Bai will definitely be more disgusted with you if he knows!"
Jiang Zhixia's patience ran out due to the quarrel, "Shut up."
Zeng Wenwen was stunned and did not react.
Jiang Zhixia was too lazy to talk to her.
This so-called best friend came from a small family and was as mentally weak as the original owner. The original owner regarded her as a true friend because of the same illness.cherish.
However, this friend used the original owner's name to gain benefits outside. From time to time, he used the original owner's favorite male Bai Zhiyu to PUA the original owner. Later, when the real daughter returned, he was also the first to jump out and add insult to injury and express his loyalty to the new princess.
Jiang Zhixia has no interest in maintaining the plastic sisterhood now, and is focusing on the man who relies on her.
The guards rushed over and helped the semi-conscious Lu Jue into the car with a calm look on his face.
She also planned to get in the car, but was blocked by Zeng Wenwen.
"Your Highness, what's going on with you today! I'm doing this for your own good! If you don't listen to me, Brother Bai will really never pay attention to you again in the future!"
"Yeah, okay," Jiang Zhixia waved her hand impatiently, "Get out of the way and don't block the road."
Zeng Wenwen was shocked.
In the past, whenever Jiang Zhixia heard that Bai Zhiyu was ignoring her, she would panic and obey her words.
What happened today?
"Your Highness Princess! Today is Brother Bai's birthday party. We will be late soon. Why don't you quickly throw this slave away and come with me?"
Jiang Zhixia didn't even raise her eyes: "Then why don't you go by yourself? Come on!"
Zeng Wenwen was shocked, a trace of embarrassment flashed in her eyes.
If Bai Zhiyu's party was not recommended by the royal family, he would not be qualified to enter.
Is she deliberately making things difficult for herself? !
She gritted her teeth and used her trump card: "You, you don't listen to me...I will never pay attention to you again!"
Jiang Zhixia finally looked at her.
She pointed to herself: "What did you call me just now?"
Zeng Wenwen was stunned: "Your Highness the Princess..."
"That's right," she smiled brightly and charmingly, "Are you also telling me what to do with this princess?"
Zeng Wenwen's face turned red instantly.
Jiang Zhixia walked around her and bent down to get into the car.
Zeng Wenwen rushed to the car angrily: "Jiang Zhixia! What do you mean! I am your only friend!"
The window slowly lowered.
Zeng Wenwen's eyes lit up, thinking she was about to give in.
Jiang Zhixia poked half of her head out to look at her.
"Oh, by the way, I don't think you are worthy of being my friend. Please break off our friendship. When you look back, remember to return all the clothes, bags, jewelry and money you have borrowed over the years."
"W-what did you say..."
Jiang Zhixia's smile became even brighter, "If you don't pay it back, I will let my eldest brother deal with your Zeng family personally."
The window rose and the hover car disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Zeng Wenwen stood there blankly.
Is she...is she crazy?
Lu Jue thought he was dead.
How else could someone touch him so tenderly?
He felt that the painful and numb wound on his body was brushed by a gentle force. Although it was weak, it was a fatal temptation...
Jiang Zhixia retracted her paws speechlessly.
After returning to the villa, she tried to mobilize her mental power to see if she could help Lu Jue relieve some of his pain.
Well, the effect is minimal.
The other party didn't even open his eyelids.
She sighed, resignedly digging out the medical kit, and applied medicine and bandage to him.
